GetClassType.description: Returns a type of the ApiSection class.

GetColumnsCount.description: Returns number of columns in this section.

GetColumnsSpaces.description: Returns an array of distance values between the columns measured in twentieths of a point (1/1440 of an inch).

GetColumnsWidths.description: Returns an array of column width values measured in twentieths of a point (1/1440 of an inch).

GetFooter.description: Returns the content for the specified footer type.

params.description: Footer type to get the content from.
params.name: sType

params.description: Specifies whether to create a new footer or not with the specified footer type in caseno footer with such a type could be found in the current section.
params.name: isCreate

GetFooterDistance.description: Returns the distance from the bottom edge of the page to the bottom edge of the footer.

GetHeader.description: Returns the content for the specified header type.

params.description: Header type to get the content from.
params.name: sType

params.description: Specifies whether to create a new header or not with the specified header type in caseno header with such a type could be found in the current section.
params.name: isCreate

GetHeaderDistance.description: Returns the distance from the top edge of the page to the top edge of the header.

GetNext.description: Returns the next section if exists.

returns.description: returns null if section is last.

GetPageHeight.description: Gets page height for current section.

GetPageMarginBottom.description: Returns the bottom page margin for all pages in the current section.

GetPageMarginLeft.description: Returns the left page margin for all pages in the current section.

GetPageMarginRight.description: Returns the right page margin for all pages in the current section.

GetPageMarginTop.description: Returns the top page margin for all pages in the current section.

GetPageWidth.description: Gets page width for current section.

GetPrevious.description: Returns the previous section if exists.

returns.description: returns null if section is first.

GetStartPageNumber.description: Returns the start page number of the specified section.

RemoveFooter.description:
Removes the footer of the specified type from the current section. After removal, the footer will be inherited from 
the previous section, or if this is the first section in the document, no footer of the specified type will be presented.

params.description: Footer type to be removed.
params.name: sType

RemoveHeader.description:
Removes the header of the specified type from the current section. After removal, the header will be inherited from
the previous section, or if this is the first section in the document, no header of the specified type will be presented.

params.description: Header type to be removed.
params.name: sType

SetEqualColumns.description: Specifies that all the text columns in the current section are of equal width.

params.description: Number of columns.
params.name: nCount

params.description: Distance between columns measured in twentieths of a point (1/1440 of an inch).
params.name: nSpace

SetFooterDistance.description: Specifies the distance from the bottom edge of the page to the bottom edge of the footer.

params.description: The distance from the bottom edge of the page to the bottom edge of the footer measuredin twentieths of a point (1/1440 of an inch).
params.name: nDistance

SetHeaderDistance.description: Specifies the distance from the top edge of the page to the top edge of the header.

params.description: The distance from the top edge of the page to the top edge of the header measured in twentieths of a point (1/1440 of an inch).
params.name: nDistance

SetMargins.description: Specifies the page margins for all the pages in this section. Alias for {@link ApiSection#SetPageMargins}.

params.description: The left margin width measured in twentieths of a point (1/1440 of an inch).
params.name: left

params.description: The top margin height measured in twentieths of a point (1/1440 of an inch).
params.name: top

params.description: The right margin width measured in twentieths of a point (1/1440 of an inch).
params.name: right

params.description: The bottom margin height measured in twentieths of a point (1/1440 of an inch).
params.name: bottom

SetMargins.signature: SetMargins(left: twips, top: twips, right: twips, bottom: twips): boolean

SetNotEqualColumns.description:
Specifies that all the columns in the current section have the different widths. Number of columns is equal 
to the length of the aWidth array. The length of the aSpaces array MUST BE equal to (aWidth.length - 1).

params.description: An array of column width values measured in twentieths of a point (1/1440 of an inch).
params.name: aWidths

params.description: An array of distance values between the columns measured in twentieths of a point (1/1440 of an inch).
params.name: aSpaces

SetPageMargins.description: Specifies the page margins for all the pages in this section.

params.description: The left margin width measured in twentieths of a point (1/1440 of an inch).
params.name: left

params.description: The top margin height measured in twentieths of a point (1/1440 of an inch).
params.name: top

params.description: The right margin width measured in twentieths of a point (1/1440 of an inch).
params.name: right

params.description: The bottom margin height measured in twentieths of a point (1/1440 of an inch).
params.name: bottom

SetPageMargins.signature: SetPageMargins(left: twips, top: twips, right: twips, bottom: twips): boolean

SetPageSize.description: Specifies the properties (size and orientation) for all the pages in the current section.

params.description: The page width measured in twentieths of a point (1/1440 of an inch).
params.name: nWidth

params.description: The page height measured in twentieths of a point (1/1440 of an inch).
params.name: nHeight

params.description: Specifies the orientation of all the pages in this section (if set to true, then the portrait orientation is chosen).
params.name: isPortrait

SetPageSize.signature: SetPageSize(nWidth: twips, nHeight: twips, isPortrait?: boolean): boolean

SetStartPageNumber.description: Sets the start page number for the specified section.

params.description: The start page number.
params.name: nStartNumber

SetTitlePage.description: Specifies whether the current section in this document has the different header and footer for the section first page.

params.description: If true, the first page of the section will have header and footer that will differ from the other pages of the same section.
params.name: isTitlePage

SetType.description:
Specifies a type of the current section. The section type defines how the contents of the current 
section are placed relative to the previous section.

params.description: The section break type.
params.name: sType

ToJSON.description: Converts the ApiSection object into the JSON object.

params.description: Specifies if the used numberings will be written to the JSON object or not.
params.name: bWriteNumberings

params.description: Specifies if the used styles will be written to the JSON object or not.
params.name: bWriteStyles
